name: HeavierHand
mechanic: Keeps a pool trading around the price it opened at, within a 10% band.
plain: The pool remembers the price it launched at. While the price stays within about 10% of that reference, a swap must pay in the side the pool has grown heavier on; once the price drifts more than 10% away, the gate flips and admits only the trade that pushes it back toward the reference, so the pool can never be shut. It works for any token pair and any starting price, not just a 1:1 pool.
rules: Everything is judged against the pool's own opening price, not an implicit 1.0.
Within about 10% of that reference you may only pay in the heavier (or equal) side.
Past the 10% band only the rebalancing leg is admitted, so the pool is never one-directional.
